title: Black is to Criminal as Caucasian is to Police: Detecting and Removing Multiclass Bias in Word Embeddings
findings: The study found that word2vec embeddings trained on Reddit data contained significant religious biases, such as associating 'jew' with 'greedy' and 'muslim' with 'uneducated' or 'powerless'. The proposed multiclass debiasing method was shown to be effective in significantly reducing these measured biases while preserving the utility of the embeddings for downstream NLP tasks.
